guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 注册 Arcus 账户
guide.description: 打开 Arcus，连接钱包或使用 Google 注册。原文称通过来源网站的链接注册可享受交易手续费减免 5%。Arcus 不向美国、加拿大、英国及其他受限地区提供服务。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to Arcus and connect your wallet or sign up with Google. Signing up through our link gives you 5% off trading fees. Arcus is not available in the US, Canada, the UK, and other restricted jurisdictions.

guide.title: 存入资金
guide.description: 将 USDC、USDT、BTC 或其他支持的资产存入 Arcus 账户。原文提供了在 Bybit 购买的选项，再通过来源页面下方的跨链组件转入 Robinhood Chain。原文还包含跨链组件入口和宣传：可在 30 多条链之间兑换或跨链，点击立即跨链（Bridge now）打开交互组件，也可在新标签页打开。宣传中的低费用和快速路由需以实际报价为准。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Deposit USDC, USDT, BTC, or another supported asset into your Arcus account. You can buy these on Bybit , then move them to Robinhood Chain with the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 现货交易股票代币
guide.description: 打开现货市场，交易 95 种以上股票代币中的任意一种。原文称现货交易不收手续费，股票代币当前享有积分加成；在美国市场常规交易时段之外交易，还有额外加成。如果使用 Robinhood Wallet，经 Arcus 路由的兑换也符合现货积分加成条件。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the spot market and trade any of the 95+ stock tokens. Spot trades carry no fees, and stock tokens currently earn boosted points. Trading outside regular US market hours adds a further boost. If you use Robinhood Wallet, swaps routed through Arcus also qualify for boosted spot points.

guide.title: 使用邀请码解锁永续合约
guide.description: 永续合约功能现在需要现有 Arcus 交易者提供的邀请码。连接 Arcus 钱包，在提示时输入邀请码；此前已获得访问权限的交易者无需邀请码。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Unlock Perps With an Invite Code
guide.original_description: Perps now require an invite code from an existing Arcus trader. Connect your wallet on Arcus and enter the code when prompted. Traders who already had access don’t need one.

guide.title: 在交易所保留抵押资产
guide.description: 留存在账户内的充值金额计入第 1 季积分。原文称在两次交易之间将抵押资产留在 Arcus，比每次交易都充值再提现更有利于积分计算。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Retained deposits count toward Season 1 points. Leaving collateral on Arcus between trades scores better than depositing and withdrawing each session.

guide.title: 查看积分进度
guide.description: 打开积分仪表盘，查看第 1 季每周积分和第 0 季排行榜名次。新积分于每周三美国东部标准时间（EST）下午 3 点发放。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the Points Dashboard to see your weekly Season 1 points and your Season 0 leaderboard rank. New points land every Wednesday at 3PM EST.

guide.title: 分享邀请码
guide.description: 永续合约累计交易量每达到 100 万美元，可获得一个邀请码；邀请来的交易者产生的交易量也计入该总量。在奖励 → 邀请（Rewards > Referrals）中查看邀请码。使用邀请码注册的用户成为被邀请者，其交易会增加邀请积分奖励。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Every $1M in perps volume earns you an invite code, and volume from traders you referred counts toward that total. Find your codes under Rewards > Referrals. Anyone who signs up with your code becomes your referral, and their trading adds to your referral points bonus.
